# BluetoothAudioReceiver source

This directory contains the receiver source from the Dream-yd fork, revision `cd9c868`, derived from Noxy229/BluetoothAudioReceiver. The original MIT license and copyright are preserved in `LICENSE`. This component is built into the release package by `tools/Build-Release.ps1`.

Upstream: https://github.com/Noxy229/BluetoothAudioReceiver
Fork: https://github.com/Dream-yd/BluetoothAudioReceiver
